description.value:
You gain proficiency with the poisoner's kit and can apply poison as a bonus action. You also learn to brew specialized poison vials: over a short or long rest, using a poisoner's kit, you can prepare two doses. These doses only function for you, and lose their potency once your next short or long rest ends.

As an action, you can use a dose to coat one vibroweapon, slug cartridge, or wrist launcher dart. A creature hit by the coated weapon attempts a Constitution save (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier), taking 1d4 plus your Intelligence modifier poison damage on a failure or half that on a success. The coating stays potent for a minute before it dries out.

Both the number of doses you can prepare and the poison's damage grow with level: three doses dealing 2d4 at 5th level, four doses dealing 3d4 at 9th level, five doses dealing 4d4 at 13th level, and six doses dealing 5d4 at 17th level.
